I don’t have any documentation with me right now, but I know for sure that the flight was delayed. Is there anything else you can do for me, or any other way to check? I really feel like I should be compensated for the inconvenience.
Yes, please transfer me to a human agent. I’d like to speak with someone who can look into this more closely. Thank you.
